chose: LLM prompt eval fixtures: one JSON file per recipe under packages/food/test/llm-enrichment, input = the CLI-rendered {{recipe_json}} payload, expected = an Opus role-play of the compiled prompt
over: storing the full compiled system prompt in every fixture
because: the prompt is not retypable (five slug lists + rules labels substituted in), so cases are generated with pnpm --filter @buttery/pipeline prompt <ids> --json; the compiled prompt is regenerable from recipeId + prompt version so duplicating ~6KB x10 would rot on the next prompt edit; user asked for reviewable fixtures only, harness comes later

chose: Ten independently-generated gold outputs disagree systematically on two axes: whether wheat/gluten may_contain may coexist with gluten_free likely on the same recipe, and whether the six shape-guess diets are emitted on every recipe (Kugelis: 13 diet rows) or only clear ones (Tamate Ka Kut: 6)
couldBe: the instrument is wrong — the thing that PRODUCED this number, not the thing it describes
the prompt underspecifies both — 'prefer may_contain when unsure' and the 0.6 ceiling say how to grade a judgment but not when to make one
the variance is model sampling noise and would shrink with the production model at low temperature
discriminatedBy: re-run 3 of the same cases through mistralai/mistral-small-24b-instruct-2501 at the production temperature; if the same two axes swing, the prompt is underspecified, not the sampler

because: 30 production-model runs (mistral-small-24b, 10 recipes x3): 0 of 180 possible shape-guess diet judgments emitted, and speculative may_contain dropped wholesale (67 gold-only allergen decisions vs 15 contradictions). The two axes the Opus golds swung on are the same two the production model resolves in the opposite direction and does so consistently — that is a prompt that does not say WHEN to emit, not a sampler

chose: committed model-run results as packages/food/test/llm-enrichment/MODEL-RUNS.md, next to the fixtures
because: the numbers are ABOUT these fixtures and rot when the fixtures or FALLBACK_PROMPT change; a reader opening the fixture dir is the reader who needs them. Raw per-run outputs deliberately not committed - ~90 regenerable JSON blobs of model prose.

chose: empty LLM output throws inside runLlmEnrich's existing try, so it takes the transport-failure path (llm_status='error', captureEnrichmentFailed, BullMQ retry)
over: returning a distinct status from mergeLlmLabels
because: a refinement would diagnose it as a parse failure, but the model returned well-formed schema-matching JSON - what it did not do is answer; keeping them separate keeps the two failures distinguishable in the message a human reads. Retry rather than give up because the observed empties were transient: qwen returned empty on 1 of 3 runs for two recipes while the other runs were correct.

chose: spot-fixed empty-output-writes-as-success; the CLASS is pinned, not dissolved
over: removing the .default() calls that make {} parse
because: the defaults ARE the sparse encoding - an omitted allergens array must keep meaning 'found none', so the state that allows {} cannot be made unrepresentable without breaking the feature. Pinned instead by isEmptyLlmOutput plus schema.test.ts's 'ACCEPTS {} - which is exactly why isEmptyLlmOutput has to exist', which goes red if the guard is deleted. refutations: observed twice in 30 qwen runs, once on a cookie recipe with eggs/butter/wheat flour recorded as detecting no allergens.

chose: ship gemini with the Teriyaki gluten_free miss unfixed; prompt refinement deferred to a later pass
over: adding the packaged-sauce prompt line and re-running the fixtures now
because: user's call, explicitly accepted. Severity is real and recorded rather than forgotten: gemini emitted gluten_free:likely on 2 of 3 runs for a recipe with 1/2 cup soy sauce, and likely is the ONLY diet verdict recipe-tags.ts surfaces to users, so it is user-visible where the other findings are not. packages/food/test/llm-enrichment/MODEL-RUNS.md carries the reproducer and is the thing to re-run when the pass happens.
